verdict.rationale: AuthKit is documented as a spec-compatible OAuth authorization server whose OAuth applications use the `authorization_code` flow. Official SDKs (React, Astro, TanStack Start, iOS) provide PKCE sign-in, PKCE public-client mode and automatic token refresh, so developers do not hand-roll protocol details. The Device Authorization Flow is also supported for CLIs. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of OIDC-specific artifacts for the developer's own app (ID tokens, discovery endpoint), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the OAuth/PKCE flows rather than of SSO/SAML.
